item.title: Ep 1 — Attachment as the Map: Safe Haven and A.R.E.
item.description: Why EFT treats relationship distress as a threat to the attachment bond rather than a skills deficit, and how anxious hyper-activation and avoidant deactivation shape pursuit and withdrawal. Listeners learn the A.R.E. test (Accessible, Responsive, Engaged) and why "effective dependency" produces more autonomy, not less.

item.title: Ep 2 — Where Gottman's Skills Meet EFT's Attachment Depth
item.description: How the Sound Relationship House and gentle start-up function as behavioral scaffolding while EFT supplies the attachment fear underneath a harsh start-up. Includes the overlap between Gottman's Atone-Attune-Attach affair recovery and EFT's Attachment Injury Repair Model.

item.title: Ep 3 — The Cycle Is the Enemy, Not the Partner
item.description: How to name and de-escalate the pursuer-distancer dance by separating reactive secondary emotions (anger, numbness) from the primary attachment emotions beneath them. Walks through Stage 1's four steps and maps Gottman's Four Horsemen onto each partner's position in the cycle.

item.title: Ep 4 — Polyvagal States Behind Pursuit, Shutdown, and Co-Regulation
item.description: Maps the pursuer onto sympathetic fight-or-flight and the distancer onto dorsal vagal shutdown, explaining why neither partner can reason their way out of a cycle. Shows how softening and responsiveness work as literal co-regulation back into ventral vagal social engagement.

item.title: Ep 5 — The Therapist as Choreographer: Running the EFT Tango
item.description: A technical breakdown of the couple's Tango: mirroring present process, assembling affect through trigger-perception-body-meaning-action, staging the enactment, processing the receiver's response, and integrating the new interaction. Explains why the therapist directs traffic rather than discusses it, and why enactments outperform talking about problems.

item.description: How to spot the loop where a client touches "I'm not enough" and immediately gallops into criticism, and how slicing it thinner and empathic conjecture keep them in the felt sense. Covers the trap of staging an enactment before the shame is fully cooked and validated.
